:::{#def-level-set}
#### Level set

Let $f : \reals^p \to \reals$,
and let $c$ be a [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers).
The **level set**
[@wikipedia_level_set]
of $f$ at $c$ is the [preimage](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-preimage) of the single value $c$ under $f$:

$$
\levelsetof{c}{f} \eqdef \preimage{f}{\cb{c}}.
$$

:::
